newsitem.title: KENYA: Kenya shilling stengthens slightly against dollar.
newsitem.headline: Kenya shilling stengthens slightly against dollar.

text.p: The Kenyan shilling gained slightly against the dollar on Friday in a calm market.
The Central Bank of Kenya posted a shilling mean rate 56.05 against the dollar from 56.07 on Thursday. On the pound, it was posted at an average of 87.54, unchanged from Thursday.
"There was not much activity in the market. The demand and supply for hard currencies was low," a commercial banker said.
"The dollar slid down against the local unit as inflows from the agriculture sector were experienced," a dealer said.
"The market opened at 56.05/15 and soon broke the 56 level to settle at 55.90/05 before importers came in, taking advantage of the low prices to buy dollars," she said.

Another dealer said "The Central Bank also bought dollars at 56.08. The CBK seems determined to keep the dollar at above 56. The shilling appreciated against the other international currencies due to their weakness internationally.
"The market looks set to close the week at 56.00/10, having found a temporary stability level," he said.
Dealers said overnight money market rates remained above 20 percent levels.
